description: Plugin-distributed hooks for web-design. Auto-merged with the consumer's session hooks when the plugin is installed.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -u BASH_ENV -u ENV -u SHELLOPTS -u BASHOPTS -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT -u DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES -u DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONSTARTUP PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/check-web-anti-patterns.sh" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"
hooks.comment: Flag web anti-patterns: oversized raster images, missing alt, hardcoded hex colors outside token files, HTML pages missing /<meta description>, accidental noindex. Advisory by default; flip exit 0 to exit 1 to enforce.
